title: Vancouver Local Taste Trail
blurb: Our intimate tour, limited to 8 people, offers an insider's look at Vancouver's coolest food spots. You'll taste amazing smash burgers, gooey chocolate chip cookies, and local craft beverages while enjoying exclusive views of mountains and water. We mix must-try eats with hidden gems, giving you a proper local perspective of Vancouver's vibrant food scene. It's a laid-back adventure perfect for food lovers seeking authentic experiences beyond typical tourist spots.
